author: KEXP
description: Under the musical project Whitney, Max Kakacek and Julien Elrich return to warm, pastoral folk rock on their latest release 'Small Talk.' In-studio with host Hans Fluegel, the duo share a performance of "Dandelions" and more.
title: Whitney performs "Dandelions" & more Live on KEXP
